name: Dorm No. 52
source:
A murderous ghost… your dream college… two handsome crushes. Will you enjoy your new life or run for your life? You decide.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一個要殺人的鬼魂……你夢想中的大學……兩個令你心動的帥哥。你會好好享受新生活，還是會為了保命拔腿就跑？由你決定。
